title: Oracle nondeterminism characterizes exponential time
statement: The class of Boolean languages decidable by a nondeterministic oracle Turing machine with oracle $\mathrm{EXPCOM}$, in time bounded by a constant multiple of $n^c+1$ for some natural number $c$, is exactly $\mathrm{EXP}$, the union over natural numbers $c$ of deterministic time classes with bounds a constant multiple of $2^{n^c}$.
hypotheses_covered: nondeterministic oracle running time is bounded by a constant multiple of $n^c+1$ for some natural number $c$
the deterministic exponential-time bounds are $2^{n^c}$ for natural numbers $c$
replaced:
The class of languages decidable by a nondeterministic oracle machine with oracle
$	ext{EXPCOM}$ in time $n^c+1$, up to a constant factor, is exactly $	ext{EXP}$, the
union over $d\in\mathbb{N}$ of deterministic time classes with bounds proportional to
$2^{n^d}$.
